Fantastic for people watching
Dec 2018 • Friends
This is a very busy bar and therefore you can expect to have to wait a little while for food and drink service. It's very laid back, so don't be impatient and relax and soak up the atmosphere. 

The bar sits on the first floor overlooking the main roundabout at the lake and is a great place to people watch and see the organised chaos of all the mopeds weaving in and out of the traffic, people trying to cross the road etc. Spot the new tourists waiting to cross. They stand for ages. 

The food is bar food so don't expect a gourmet meal, but it tastes great when it arrives. 

Give this place a try one afternoon or at sunset and watch the world go by and take it all in. You'll have a great time.
